verdict.rationale: Databricks publishes a workspace-level REST API reference covering types, paths, payloads and examples. The APIs are versioned with documented migration guidance, and REST, CLI and Python SDK are named as ways to work with platform objects, so the platform can be driven programmatically through a documented public API. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec was found at the probed paths, no independent hands-on corroboration of API use, and a community report that usage info is hard to get programmatically.
